<!-- pr-reviewer: 7a5055a7cfe009138b3f50f3dfd30361b80a4ca2 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The change gives each catalog case separate regeneration and rebuild results. The shared helpers keep the existing NC comparisons and portability checks. Each rebuild removes only its own case directory.

Results, locally against upstream/main `61a817bed26bf42bf285638d5db337980bea6d0b`:

- Trial merge: clean. The PR already contains this main commit.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. The full `example_catalog` suite had 16 passes, no failures, and no ignored tests. Build and tests took 336 seconds. The tests took 14.28 seconds.
- All ten workflows passed. Each printed its name, time, and 60-second budget. Times were 0.424 to 14.277 seconds.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Heavy lanes: the dry-run plan selects `app heavy: example_catalog`. `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog -- --list --ignored` lists zero tests. No heavy tests exist in this suite. The release build did not run.

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no fixtures, golden files, or importer code. The extra fixture and importer rules do not apply.

Mutation checks: no source mutations were run. This PR changes test structure and timing only. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, or stock simulation. The suite passed its two-broken-case contract for both workflows and its timeout contract. The author's source mutation results remain author evidence.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: No goldens moved. No UI screenshots are required. The timeout reports a failure but cannot cancel the worker thread. The PR states this limit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge class: SAME (no commit after the reviewed head). This merge relies on the review by mkinney with the marker for head `7a5055a7cfe009138b3f50f3dfd30361b80a4ca2`. The PR changes tests, examples and a decision file only.
